name: profile_true_3x2_experimental
summary: Exact native 3:2 window. Same output (3840x2560) as the stable profile but read from the FULL 3:2 sensor window 5952x3968 starting at row 94, instead of the contributed 5952x3876 from row 214. Capturing all 3968 native rows removes the ~2.4% height stretch (3876/3968 = 0.977). NEVER RUN ON ANY A6700. Treat as a first-light experiment.

sensor_window.note: 5952x3968 is the exact 3:2 read-out (3968 = 5952 * 2/3). 94 + 3968 = 4062. The 3968 row COUNT fits the 3980-line dmmwb write buffer; the first-row register (94) is below 256 and has never been exercised.

verify_rule: Read every write's address first; each must equal its 'stock'. Abort the whole profile on any mismatch. Because no A6700 has run this window, the experimental steps carry NO target fingerprints: the encoder/sensor payload must be regenerated for 3968 by the GPL kit's apply32 and dropped into payloads/.

steps.label: raw write buffer (memory manager)
steps.desc: Enlarge the four raw write-buffer size words for 3840x2560 sourced from a 3968-row window.

writes.derivation: recompute buffer byte-size for width 5952 x 3968 rows at apply time; must be <= the 3980-line dmmwb buffer.

steps.label: sensor drive window (exact 3:2)
steps.desc: Open the sensor window to the full 3968 rows from row 94. Geometry is declarative; register bytes are firmware-derived and must be regenerated for this window.
steps.payload_note: No fingerprints: this window has never been generated or run. Build with the GPL kit (apply32) and verify stock-before-write only.
steps.risk: first_row 94 (< 256) is an untested sensor-register range: possible black frame or kernel reboot, like the L19 encoder crash. A battery pull clears it.

steps.label: encoder output size
steps.desc: Output size word stays 3840x2560; the difference from the stable profile is purely the taller, un-squeezed source window.

steps.label: full encoder design for the 3968 window
steps.desc: Full encoder design regenerated for a 3968-row window. No verified bytes exist.
steps.payload_note: Firmware-derived AND unverified. NOT in this MIT repo and no fingerprint is known. Regenerate with the GPL kit's apply32 for 5952x3968.

steps.label: screen / display fit
steps.desc: Same rear-panel fit as the stable profile (full 3:2 panel, letterbox off).

notes: EXPERIMENTAL. Never run on any A6700. Do not mix with the stable profile in the same session.
RAM only: battery out ~10 s reverts. Keep the battery handy during the first attempt.
If the picture is black or the body restarts, pull the battery and fall back to profile_4k_24p_stable.
